text: The Vorgol natural bottled-water brand is sold through Trade Company "Double Black" (OOO «Дабл Блэк», Moscow), which the brand's official site vorgolmsk.ru names as its exclusive distributor; the site's public offer and contact details are OOO «ДАБЛ БЛЭК» (Moscow, ul. Taldomskaya 2G, office@dblack.ru).
short: The Vorgol water brand is run by its exclusive distributor OOO «Дабл Блэк»

source.name: Vorgol official site (vorgolmsk.ru), footer
source.note: Footer credit line of the brand's own site; translates as 'Exclusive distributor of Trade Company "Double Black"'. The site's public-offer link is titled 'Публичная оферта интернет-магазина ООО «ДАБЛ БЛЭК»' and its Moscow address and office@dblack.ru match OOO «ДАБЛ БЛЭК».
